purpose: Compare the observable fitted ASD shape across fixed C_tes anchors and determine whether the large C_tes-dependent Magnicon+c2 transfer changes are cancelled by the TES model and profiled white floor.
guardrail: The full fitted ASD is the observable model comparison; the zero-post-filter-white spectrum is a decomposition diagnostic, not a separately measured quantity. Small full-ASD anchor sensitivity alongside large readout-transfer sensitivity would demonstrate non-identifiability/cancellation, not identify which decomposition is physically correct. Rows where c2 hits a configured bound are censored and excluded from the primary finite-shape classification.
